definitions.explanation: A deep-seated feeling of resentment or hatred, often so strong it is believed to persist even after death. Frequently used in discussions of ghosts and supernatural themes.

examples.japanese: {怨念|おんねん}が{籠|こ}もった{場所|ばしょ}だ。
examples.english: This is a place filled with lingering resentment.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}の{怨念|おんねん}は{深|ふか}い。
{怨念|おんねん}を{晴|は}らすために{復讐|ふくしゅう}した。
examples.english: He took revenge to settle his grudge.

notes:
SUPERNATURAL CONTEXT:
In Japanese folklore and horror, {怨念|おんねん} is often associated with:
・{怨霊|おんりょう} (vengeful spirit)
・{地縛霊|じばくれい} (earthbound spirit)
・{呪|のろ}い (curse)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{怨念|おんねん}を{抱|いだ}く (to harbor a grudge)
・{怨念|おんねん}を{晴|は}らす (to clear one's grudge)
・{怨念|おんねん}が{籠|こ}もる (to be filled with resentment)

RELATED TERMS:
・{恨|うら}み (grudge, resentment)
・{遺恨|いこん} (lingering resentment)
・{憎悪|ぞうお} (hatred)
